title: Max builds a pool (four disasters later)

beats.text: This is Max. His brand new pool just floated out of the ground.
Let's go back to day one.
Max wants a pool for his kids. Step one: dig a hole. Fifty tons of dirt. Easy.
Fill it with water and... it's gone. Soil is basically a sponge.
So, concrete walls. Solid. What could go wrong?
Twenty tons of water, that's what. Concrete hates being stretched. It cracks, and it all leaks out.
The real fix: a steel cage, a bar every 25 centimeters, then concrete sprayed on. The steel takes the stretch.
Then it has to stay damp for four weeks. Max sleeps. The sprinkler doesn't.
Plaster, tiles, a ladder. Fill it up. Finally!
Then a storm. Max drains it to clean it, and groundwater lifts the empty pool like a boat.
The fix: gravel underneath, and a relief valve that lets groundwater in instead of pushing up.
Refilled. A week later: soup. Still water plus sunshine equals algae.
So a pump pushes it all through a sand filter, the whole pool every six hours. Plus one chlorine duck.
Four disasters later, it finally works. Kids? Cannonball! Which disaster would you have seen coming?
